eval: (async () => { await import('/sandbox/party_follow.js'); PF.suite = 'party.follow.campaign'; const r = await PF.ready(); await PF.idle(); const none = PF.nobody(); await PF.sleep(1000); window.__pf = { p0: PF.programs() }; return JSON.stringify({ ...r, none, level: __game.state().campaign.level }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const a = await __game.party.join('elder'); const b = await __game.party.join('innkeeper'); PF.fakeUI(); PF.expect(!!a && !!b, 'two villagers of the town join'); const recs = g.story.state.party; PF.expect(recs.map((r) => r.id).join() === 'elder,innkeeper' && recs.every((r) => r.level === 'emberfall'), 'the records are in the story state (written after every change), with the level they joined in: ' + JSON.stringify(recs.map((r) => [r.id, r.level]))); const hidden = PF.checkHidden('the town'); await PF.sleep(2000); PF.expect(PF.programs() === __pf.p0, 'no program compiled by the joins: ' + PF.programs()); return JSON.stringify({ hidden, members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { const r = await PF.travel('door_inn'); PF.expect(r.ok && r.level === 'inn' && r.attached === 2 && r.scene === 2 && r.members === 2, 'into the inn: the members come along (attached, two sprites in the scene): ' + JSON.stringify(r)); PF.expect(r.placed.every((p) => p === 'placed'), 'placed behind the player at the entrance: ' + JSON.stringify(r.placed)); PF.expect(r.programs[0] === r.programs[1], 'no program compiled after the arrival: ' + JSON.stringify(r.programs)); const placed = PF.checkPlaced('the inn', { behind: false }); return JSON.stringify({ r, placed, members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const P = g.player.position; const r = await PF.drive([[P.x, P.z - 1.4]], { label: 'a few steps in the inn', warm: 99 }); PF.checkDrive(r); return JSON.stringify({ reached: r.reached, rest: await PF.checkRest('in the inn') }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const pl = g.player; pl.facing.set(0, 0, 1); pl.sprite.faceVector(0, 1); __game.teleport(2.5, 2.5); await PF.frame(); const P = pl.position; const at = g.party.members.map((m) => ({ id: m.id, x: +m.position.x.toFixed(2), z: +m.position.z.toFixed(2), st: g.party._standable(m.position.x, m.position.z), reach: PF.reachable(P.x, P.z, m.position.x, m.position.z), mode: m.follow.mode })); PF.expect(at.every((x) => x.st && x.reach), 'a teleport into the inn\'s corner facing the counter: every member on standable ground it can walk to from the player (straight or round a corner; none inside the counter): ' + JSON.stringify(at)); const sw = PF.sweep(0.5); PF.expect(sw.bad === 0, 'placements everywhere in the inn (4 facings): none on a spot it cannot stand on or walk to: ' + JSON.stringify(sw)); return JSON.stringify({ at, sweep: sw }); })()

(async () => { const r = await PF.travel('exit_out'); PF.expect(r.ok && r.level === 'emberfall' && r.kept === true && r.attached === 2 && r.scene === 2, 'out again: the town attached again (set aside), the members with the player, no member twice: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); const aside = __game.game.campaign._aside.room?.id ?? null; PF.expect(aside === 'inn', 'the inn is set aside (and kept no member): ' + aside); PF.expect(r.programs[0] === r.programs[1], 'no program compiled after the arrival: ' + JSON.stringify(r.programs)); const hidden = PF.checkHidden('the town again'); return JSON.stringify({ r, hidden, members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { const m = PF.member('innkeeper'); await PF.sleep(500); const at = [m.position.x, m.position.z]; __game.party.leave('innkeeper'); const npc = PF.npc('innkeeper'); PF.expect(npc.present && Math.hypot(npc.position.x - at[0], npc.position.z - at[1]) < 0.05, 'on its own level a member who leaves is its villager again, where it stood'); const st = __game.game.story; const home = st.state.levelMemory(st.levelId).homes.innkeeper; PF.expect(Array.isArray(home) && Math.hypot(home[0] - at[0], home[1] - at[1]) < 0.01 && Math.hypot(npc.home.x - at[0], npc.home.z - at[1]) < 0.01, 'and stays there: its home, kept in the story (a campaign save holds it): ' + JSON.stringify({ home, at })); const r1 = await PF.travel('door_inn'); const r2 = await PF.travel('exit_out'); PF.expect(r1.ok && r2.ok && r1.attached === 1 && r2.attached === 1 && r2.scene === 1 && r1.kept === true && r2.kept === true, 'in and out again (both set aside): one member, attached both ways: ' + JSON.stringify([r1, r2])); PF.expect(PF.npc('innkeeper').present && PF.npc('innkeeper').sprite.visible, 'the villager who left stays in the town'); return JSON.stringify({ r1, r2 }); })()

(async () => { const r1 = await PF.travel('door_inn'); __game.party.leave('elder'); PF.expect(PF.attached() === 0 && PF.scene().members === 0, 'a member who leaves elsewhere goes'); const r2 = await PF.travel('exit_out'); const npc = PF.npc('elder'); const home = Math.hypot(npc.position.x - npc.home.x, npc.position.z - npc.home.z); PF.expect(r2.ok && r2.kept && npc.present && npc.sprite.visible && home < 0.5, 'back in the town (set aside while the elder left): the elder is at home again: ' + JSON.stringify([r2.kept, npc.present, home])); PF.expect(!__game.game._map.party?.length && __game.game._map.npcs.includes(npc.position), 'the maps: no party dot, the elder\'s dot back'); return JSON.stringify({ r1, r2, home }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; await __game.party.join('elder'); await PF.sleep(800); const orig = g._buildLevel; g._buildLevel = async (...a) => { g._buildLevel = orig; await orig.apply(g, a); PF.expect(PF.attached() === 1, 'the members attached to the level being built (before it fails)'); throw new Error('party.follow.campaign: building the inn fails (on purpose)'); }; const r = await PF.travel('door_inn'); const g2 = __game.game; PF.expect(!r.ok && r.level === 'emberfall' && g2.mode === 'play', 'a travel whose build fails (after the members attached to it): back in the town: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); PF.expect(PF.attached() === 1 && PF.scene().members === 1 && g2.party.members.length === 1, 'after the rollback: the member once, attached, one sprite in the scene: ' + JSON.stringify([PF.attached(), PF.scene().members])); const hidden = PF.checkHidden('after the rollback'); const r2 = await PF.travel('door_inn'); const r3 = await PF.travel('exit_out'); PF.expect(r2.ok && r3.ok && r3.attached === 1 && r3.scene === 1, 'in and out after the failure: the member with the player'); return JSON.stringify({ r, hidden, r2, r3 }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const st = g.story.state; st.party = /** a save's records, unchecked */ ([{ id: 'elder', name: 'Elder Maren', preset: 'elder', cls: 'bogus', rule: { target: 'nope', heal: 'often', extra: 1 } }, { id: 'elder', name: 'Twice' }, { id: 'bad id!' }, { id: 5 }, null, { id: 'guard', name: 'Corporal Hale', preset: 'nope', color: 'red' }, { id: 'farmer', name: 'Old Tobin', preset: 'farmer' }, { id: 'child', name: 'Pip', preset: 'child' }]); st.version++; const info = await __game.party.sync(); const ms = info.members; PF.expect(ms.map((m) => m.id).join() === 'elder,guard,farmer', 'records from a save are checked: no id twice, no bad id, at most three: ' + JSON.stringify(ms.map((m) => m.id))); PF.expect(ms[0].cls === 'warden' && ms[0].rule.target === 'leader' && ms[0].rule.heal === 'often' && !('extra' in ms[0].rule), 'a bad class and a bad rule field repaired, the good field kept: ' + JSON.stringify([ms[0].cls, ms[0].rule])); PF.expect(g.party.records[1].preset === 'villager' && g.party.records[1].color === '#c9a45c', 'a bad preset and colour repaired'); PF.expect(st.party.map((r) => r.id).join() === 'elder,guard,farmer' && __game.campaign.save(), 'the state keeps the checked records (the next save writes no bad one)'); await PF.frame(); await PF.frame(); PF.expect(PF.attached() === 3 && PF.scene().members === 3, 'the new members arrive behind the player'); PF.checkHidden('after a sync'); st.setParty([]); const none = await __game.party.sync(); await PF.sleep(300); PF.expect(none.members.length === 0 && PF.scene().members === 0 && ['elder', 'guard', 'farmer'].every((id) => PF.npc(id).present && PF.npc(id).sprite.visible), 'synced to no member: the members go, their villagers are back'); return JSON.stringify({ ids: ms.map((m) => [m.id, m.cls, m.preset]), after: none.members.length }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; await __game.party.join('elder'); await PF.sleep(500); const saved = __game.campaign.save(); const key = Object.keys(localStorage).find((k) => k.startsWith('luminati.campaign.emberfall-interiors')); const raw = key ? JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)) : null; const hasParty = Array.isArray(raw?.story?.party) && raw.story.party.some((r) => r.id === 'elder'); sessionStorage.setItem('pf.saved', JSON.stringify({ hasParty, failed: PF.failed })); PF.expect(saved, 'the game saves'); return JSON.stringify({ saved, key, hasParty }); })()

(async () => { await import('/sandbox/party_follow.js'); PF.suite = 'party.follow.campaign'; await PF.ready(); await PF.idle(); const note = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('pf.saved') ?? '{}'); const g = __game.game; let result; if (note.hasParty) { PF.expect(g.party?.members.length === 1 && PF.attached() === 1 && !PF.npc('elder').present, 'Continue: the saved party is back (the member behind the player, its villager hidden)'); result = 'checked'; } else { PF.expect(g.party === null, 'Continue without a party in the save: no party'); result = 'skipped: the save holds no party yet (StoryState.toJSON — the story package)'; } return JSON.stringify({ note, result, members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { await import('/sandbox/party_follow.js'); PF.suite = 'party.follow.campaign'; await PF.ready(); __game.story?.auto(true); await PF.idle(); await PF.sleep(800); window.__pf = { p0: PF.programs() }; const a = await __game.party.join('hollis'); const b = await __game.party.join('pip'); PF.fakeUI(); PF.expect(!!a && !!b, 'Millbrook: Hollis and Pip join'); const hidden = PF.checkHidden('Millbrook'); __game.campaign.setFlag('pf-test'); await PF.frame(); await PF.frame(); await PF.frame(); PF.expect(!PF.npc('hollis').present && !PF.npc('pip').present, 'a story change does not bring a member\'s villager back'); return JSON.stringify({ hidden, members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { __game.story.set('hollis-at-ford', 1); await PF.idle(); const ok = await __game.campaign.travel('mill-road', ''); await PF.idle(); await PF.frame(); const at = PF.programs(); await PF.sleep(1200); const s = __game.state(); const ford = PF.npc('hollis_ford'); const present = __game.game.story.present(__game.game.level.objects.find((o) => o.id === 'hollis_ford')); PF.expect(ok && s.campaign.level === 'mill-road' && PF.attached() === 2 && PF.scene().members === 2, 'travel to the Mill Road: the members come along: ' + JSON.stringify(PF.brief())); PF.expect(!ford.present && !ford.sprite.visible, 'the Mill Road\'s Hollis (the same actor, another id) is hidden while Hollis is in the party (the story would show him: ' + present + ')'); PF.expect(at === PF.programs(), 'no program compiled after the arrival: ' + at + ' / ' + PF.programs()); return JSON.stringify({ level: s.campaign.level, members: PF.brief(), fordPresentByStory: present }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const P = g.player.position; const r = await PF.drive([[P.x + 4, P.z], [P.x + 7, P.z + 0.5]], { label: 'the Mill Road' }); PF.checkDrive(r); const rest = await PF.checkRest('the Mill Road'); let talk = 'skipped: the story has a talk script for the member (StoryRunner.talkFor)'; if (!g.story.talkFor) { const t = await PF.talk('pip', [2]); PF.expect(t.speaker === 'Pip' && t.offered[0]?.join('|') === 'Tactics…|Part ways|Carry on', 'a member without a talk script (no StoryRunner.talkFor yet): the party conversation: ' + JSON.stringify(t)); talk = t; } return JSON.stringify({ drive: r.reached, rest, talk }); })()
